ModMetaData.name: EponaInstrumentsRenew - Pickle pre-split check
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description: Development only, never published. The second test companion of Epona Instruments Renew (unofficial): it holds the two features that play the hand-over of a saved game between two launches (`-Filter 50-pre-split-write -Then 51-pre-split-read`, pass `pre-split`), and it is where the first launch leaves the save that the second launch loads. It is staged only by that pass, so the plain suite does not see it.
